texts.welcome: Welcome home. The ways we take care of each other, giving from the heart.
texts.unfinished_note: Want to talk about this one at family meeting?
texts.offline_note: Will sync when you're back online.
texts.meeting_intro: A look at our week together.

starter.name: Tidy your room
starter.why: So you can find your things and rest in a calm space.
starter.thanks: Your room is tidy. Now you can find your things and rest easy.

starter.name: Do the dishes
starter.why: So we have clean dishes and room to cook.
starter.thanks: The dishes are done. Now we have room to cook dinner.

starter.name: Quick tidy of the living room
starter.why: So everyone has a nice place to sit together.
starter.thanks: The living room is picked up. Now there's a nice place for all of us to sit together.

starter.name: General tidy
starter.why: Put away anything of yours that's out around the house, so the house feels peaceful for everyone.
starter.thanks: Your things are put away. The house feels peaceful for everyone.

starter.name: Wash your clothes
starter.why: So you have clean clothes to wear.
starter.thanks: Your clothes are washing. Soon you'll have clean clothes to wear.

starter.name: Wash your sheets
starter.why: So your bed is fresh and you sleep well.
starter.thanks: Your sheets are clean. Your bed will be fresh tonight.

starter.name: Hang up your laundry or put it in the dryer
starter.why: So it dries and doesn't sour in the washer.
starter.thanks: Your laundry is out of the washer. Now it can dry fresh instead of souring.

starter.name: Fold and put away your clean laundry
starter.why: So your clothes stay neat and easy to find.
starter.thanks: Your clothes are folded and put away. They'll be neat and easy to find.

starter.name: Clean the living room
starter.why: Dust, vacuum, and wipe down, so the room stays healthy and welcoming.
starter.thanks: The living room is clean. It's a healthy, welcoming place to be.

starter.name: Clean the porch
starter.why: Sweep it off, so our home is welcoming from the moment someone walks up.
starter.thanks: The porch is swept. Our home looks welcoming the moment someone walks up.

ideas.name: Wipe the counters and table
ideas.why: So we have a clean place to cook and eat.
ideas.thanks: The counters and table are wiped. Now we have a clean place to cook and eat.

ideas.name: Set or clear the table
ideas.why: So mealtime is ready for everyone and the table is free after.
ideas.thanks: The table is ready. Now we can all sit down to eat together.

ideas.name: Help cook a meal
ideas.why: So the family is fed and the cooking is shared.
ideas.thanks: You helped cook. Now we all have a meal, and the work was shared.

ideas.name: Put away groceries
ideas.why: So cold food stays fresh and we can find what we need.
ideas.thanks: The groceries are put away. The cold food stays fresh and we can find what we need.

ideas.name: Take out trash and recycling
ideas.why: So the house stays clean and smells fresh.
ideas.thanks: The trash and recycling are out. The house stays clean and fresh.

ideas.name: Take scraps to the compost
ideas.why: So food scraps turn into rich soil for the garden.
ideas.thanks: The scraps are in the compost. They'll turn into rich soil for the garden.

ideas.name: Wipe the sink and mirror
ideas.why: So the bathroom is clean and pleasant to use.
ideas.thanks: The sink and mirror are clean. The bathroom is pleasant for everyone.

ideas.name: Clean the toilet
ideas.why: So the bathroom stays healthy for everyone.
ideas.thanks: The toilet is clean. The bathroom is healthy for all of us.

ideas.name: Hang up towels
ideas.why: So towels dry and are ready for the next person.
ideas.thanks: The towels are hung up. They'll be dry and ready for the next person.

ideas.name: Sweep or vacuum
ideas.why: So the floors are clean for walking and sitting.
ideas.thanks: The floor is swept. It's clean for walking and sitting.

ideas.name: Mop the kitchen
ideas.why: So the kitchen floor is clean and not sticky.
ideas.thanks: The kitchen floor is mopped. It's clean underfoot.

ideas.name: Water the plants or garden
ideas.why: So the plants have what they need to grow.
ideas.thanks: The plants are watered. They have what they need to grow.

ideas.name: Pull weeds
ideas.why: So the garden plants get the sun and water.
ideas.thanks: The weeds are pulled. Now the garden plants get the sun and water.

ideas.name: Bring in the mail
ideas.why: So letters and packages get to the family safe and dry.
ideas.thanks: The mail is in. Our letters and packages are safe and dry.

ideas.name: Rake leaves
ideas.why: So the yard is clear and the grass can breathe.
ideas.thanks: The leaves are raked. The yard is clear and the grass can breathe.

ideas.name: Feed and water the pets
ideas.why: So our animals are fed, safe, and cared for.
ideas.thanks: The pets have food and water. They're cared for and content.

ideas.name: Clean up after the pets
ideas.why: So our animals and our home stay clean and healthy.
ideas.thanks: The pet mess is cleaned up. Our animals and our home stay healthy.

ideas.name: Help a brother with a contribution
ideas.why: So the work is lighter and we feel like a team.
ideas.thanks: You helped your brother. The work was lighter, and you two were a team.

ideas.name: Help Mom carry something in
ideas.why: So nobody has to carry a heavy load alone.
ideas.thanks: You helped carry it in. Mom didn't have to carry that load alone.
